capabilities: Create and edit local mind maps
Switch between map, outline and table views
Import and export mind-map and document formats
Link nodes to notes and local images
Present maps and embed editable map blocks in notes
extras: Interface is currently Chinese; desktop only, with mobile unsupported. Core features are free, while optional AI generation may require a separate account and payment.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind-map editor for local visual maps that link to notes and exchange common formats.

relations.evidence: Public SimpleMindMap feature descriptions were used as a requirements reference

summary: Desktop mind-map editor that creates local .chxmap maps with rich text, layouts, outline and table views, import/export, and note links.
